input.answer: The documents don't give specific details on the root cause—they only indicate that EdgeForce had a "Model Update Rollback Error" bug causing incorrect rollbacks during model updates. This was fixed via PR https://github.com/salesforce/EdgeForce/pull/50, and the team noted a similar Kubernetes issue ("Failed Rollback of Deployment Updates," PR https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/1085) as potentially relevant to their rollback process. No further explanation of what exactly went wrong or why the procedure was changed is provided in these documents.
